title: Obtain specifically permitted RF review input
description:
Only after explicit per-action permission, send a reviewed configuration-specific inquiry to a named grantee, TCB or laboratory and retain the response. This optional external work may obtain interpretations or quotations; it is not mandatory for documenting an unresolved or no-go configuration.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: No automatic resumption from dependency completion. One approved message does not authorize follow-up contacts, agreements, purchases or filings. authority.10 and authority.12 may record denial or unverified status without this task. Separate permission is required for each external action.
acceptance_criteria: Remain deferred unless the particular external action is approved: Require recorded, scoped, explicit approval from Mark for the named action. Approval must identify the recipient, exact content and intended contact. A denied or unnecessary-contact review is valid but authorizes no message. Preserve approved inquiries, supplied configurations, response provenance and limitations. Distinguish a quote or informal opinion from a grant. No reply or inconclusive advice remains unresolved.
